newsitem.title: UK: Sterling, weak paper prices to halt Bunzl.
newsitem.headline: Sterling, weak paper prices to halt Bunzl.

text.p: A strong sterling and prevailing weak paper prices should mean the performance of British paper and plastics group Bunzl Plc remains unchanged in the first half of the current financial year, the company said on Monday.

"On current expectations, these two factors will result in the first half...being broadly similar to that of last year," Bunzl said while announcing marginal rise in its 1996 pretax profit to 113.5 million pounds ($181.7 million) against 106.2 million.
The group's sales increased by five percent to 1.58 billion pounds.
Bunzl offered a total dividend of 6.3 pence per share, up from 5.8 pence in the previous year while its earnings per share rose to 16.4 pence from 15.5 pence.
The company had sold its European fine paper businesses, Seiler Papier and Bunzl Italia, to the KNP BT Group for 60 million pounds.
Bunzl, however, said it remained committed to its fine paper business in UK and Ireland. ($ = 0.624 British Pounds)
